author: Huawei
description:
How do you guarantee smooth streaming when millions tune in at once? STARZPLAY, a video-on-demand subscription platform serving 2.4 million+ subscribers across 22 countries, has the answers. 

Watch the latest #Huawei #TransformTalks with CTO Faraz Arshad to discover how STARZPLAY delivers flawless, large-scale streaming in one of the world's most competitive markets: https://bit.ly/3Z5hn6r #HuaweiCloud #ThisIsHuawei
title: When Every Second Matters: Seamless Streaming at Scale
